actor.description: The actor whose active signing key is being emergency-rotated. Must agree with the envelope subject. Cross-actor emergency rotation is invalid.

subject.description: Internal reference of the same actor: 'actor:<self-actor-id>'.

created_at.description: Strict RFC 3339 UTC seconds (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). The verifier treats this as the causal position at which next_key becomes active.

bytes.description: Raw ed25519 public key bytes encoded with standard base64. The signature on this statement is produced by an attestation key, not by next_key.

oneOf.description: StatementId of the prior key event (any rotation or revocation, emergency or routine) for the same actor. Cross-actor supersedes is invalid.
First key event after ActorGenesis. The signature must be produced by an attestation key declared in ActorGenesis.attestation_keys.

signature.description: Must be produced by a key in the actor's attestation set at created_at: ActorGenesis.attestation_keys ∪ all ActorAttestationKeyAdd.new_key with created_at <= this statement's created_at. See ACTORS.md §5.5.2.
